role: Fitness-tab 'Sensors' sheet: manage the Polar strap (pair, reconnect, disconnect, stop scan, swipe-to-forget; Disconnect and Forget of the connected strap ask for confirmation while it feeds a recording), Stryd/FTMS foot pod or bike trainer, and Concept2 PM5, each as a List section driven by its manager's connection state.
types: SensorManagementSheet: struct View — the sheet; Polar section built inline
SensorManagementSheet.StrapRelease: enum — a pending .disconnect or .forget(KnownDevice) waiting for confirmation
FootPodRow: private struct View — FootPodManager (via dependencies) read into AccessorySensorRow
PM5Row: private struct View — Concept2Manager (via dependencies) read into AccessorySensorRow
AccessorySensorRow: private struct View — shared status/badge/buttons/discovered list for a BLE accessory (Link, Device, Content, Actions)
DiscoveredSensorButton: private struct View — one tap-to-pair row for a scanned device (Polar, foot pod and PM5)
toplevel: No globals. @State pendingRelease: StrapRelease? (nil until a Disconnect/Forget during a recording asks for confirmation). Accessibility identifiers 'sensors.root' and 'sensors.pairStrap' used by UI tests.

units.does: List with polar, foot pod and PM5 sections wrapped in the strap-release confirmation (withStrapReleaseConfirmation), inline 'Sensors' title and a Done toolbar button calling onDismiss.
